title: Sclerotherapy for veins
what: The doctor injects medicine into an enlarged vein with a thin needle. The vein seals shut and fades over time.
why: For spider veins and small varicose veins on the legs.
duration: a session usually takes 15 to 40 minutes; several sessions are usually needed
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners and hormones
Past blood clots in the veins, in you or relatives
If you are pregnant or breastfeeding

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: A leg vein ultrasound is usually done before the procedure.

prepare.title: Stockings
prepare.text: Buy compression stockings in the right size in advance. They go on right after the procedure. Your doctor will tell you the strength.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: Do not put cream on your legs that day. Avoid tanning before the course.

steps: The skin is wiped with antiseptic
The doctor makes several injections into the veins with a thin needle
Sometimes the medicine is given as a foam, guided by ultrasound
The injection sites are covered, and a compression stocking is put on
Right after, you are asked to walk for 20 to 30 minutes
feel: Later, an ache along the vein
after: Wear the stockings for as long as your doctor said
Walk every day and avoid sitting for long
No saunas, hot baths, or tanning for a few weeks
Bruises and dark streaks along the veins can happen and fade slowly
red_flags: Severe pain, swelling, and heat in the leg
Sudden shortness of breath or chest pain: call emergency services
Redness and a small sore at an injection site

faq.a: Usually several, a few weeks apart. It depends on your veins. Your doctor will say.
Treated veins go away, but new ones can appear. Exercise and stockings, as your doctor advises, help.

reminders.text: Sclerotherapy tomorrow. Bring compression stockings and comfortable shoes. Do not put cream on your legs.
